Earthquake tremors felt in three Maharashtra districts

Mild earthquake tremors were felt in three districts of Maharashtra, including Nanded, Hingoli, and Parbhani, early Thursday morning. The National Center for Seismology (NCS) is monitoring the situation. No casualties or damage to property have been reported so far. The tremors occurred amidst heavy rainfall in the region.
